review.decision: Use the bounded original Codex rollout prefix only to recover the first start for an already recorded and currently verified successor.
review.notes: Read actual synthetic JSONL in an isolated HOME and CODEX_HOME. Use the resident rotation state machine with a fixed clock and an input spy to test the persisted handoff outcome. A separate reader case checks strict rollout identity and bounded parsing. This verifies the proposed failure mechanism without diagnosing the cause of any individual live timeout.

cases.description: Rotation can confirm from a persisted in-window first start after it leaves the rollout tail
cases.setup: Record a sent rotation and its observed Codex successor. In the successor rollout, follow a first start with more than 256 KiB of complete records. Keep one variant running and finish another after the handoff deadline.
cases.action: Verify the ordinary tail no longer reports the start. Process the rotation using the real tail and recovery readers. Process the same snapshot again.
cases.expected: The start at or after reset submission and within the original deadline confirms the same successor exactly once, even on a delayed tick. The request clears with zero paste or Enter calls.

cases.description: Missing or unrelated first starts cannot confirm a Codex rotation
cases.setup: Reuse the rotation fixture with a start before the nanosecond submission fence, a start after the deadline, metadata for a different session, competing original rollouts, missing history, only a hook, a changed live successor, or no live successor. Include an available history with no turn.
cases.action: Process before the deadline where the binding still matches, then at or after the deadline. Repeat the terminal tick.
cases.expected: No successful rotation is recorded. With the same target, the request holds before expiry and times out at its original deadline. A changed live successor fails the request. No reset or briefing input is sent in these fixtures.

cases.description: Prefix evidence requires a complete first start in a unique original rollout
cases.setup: Place candidate original, archived, or continued rollouts in an isolated Codex home. Include an alias of the same file, a separate file with the same basename, a continuation, conflicting metadata IDs, a malformed row before the start, a boundary without a turn ID, an oversized prefix, and a start without its final newline.
cases.action: Read the first persisted start by exact session ID, including a rollout whose first boundary is an end event followed by a start.
cases.expected: A complete first start in the single original is returned with nanosecond precision. Same-file aliases are accepted. Separate competing files, uncertain identities and incomplete or out-of-budget evidence yield no start.
